description: Two digital filters the audio passes through in turn, each choosing between a low pass, a high pass and a plain amplifier, and between a ladder and a biquad model

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency of Filter Unit I, 20Hz at the left end and 20000Hz at the right
Sets the cutoff frequency of Filter Unit II, 20Hz at the left end and 20000Hz at the right
Sets the resonance of Filter Unit I, from none at the bottom to full at the top
Sets the resonance of Filter Unit II, from none at the bottom to full at the top
Chooses what Filter Unit I does to the signal: Low Pass, High Pass, or VCA, which passes it through unfiltered
Chooses what Filter Unit II does to the signal: Low Pass, High Pass, or VCA, which passes it through unfiltered
Chooses the model Filter Unit I is built on, Ladder or Biquad
Chooses the model Filter Unit II is built on, Ladder or Biquad

inputs.text: The audio to be filtered; with this jack empty the module puts out 0V and nothing else happens
Added to the Unit I cutoff slider, a tenth of its travel per volt, which comes out close to 1V per octave
Added to the Unit II cutoff slider, a tenth of its travel per volt, which comes out close to 1V per octave
Added to both resonance sliders at once, a tenth of their travel per volt

notes: nothing comes out until a cable is in the audio input; the module returns 0V on every sample while that jack is empty
both filter units come up set to VCA, so a freshly placed module passes audio through without filtering it until the two type switches are moved
the panel is lettered in Japanese with the English subtitles FILTER UNIT I, FILTER UNIT II and TRAVELER over its three sections

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Unit I cutoff slider alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Unit II cutoff slider alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.3:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the two resonance sliders alone.
